subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2841
title: Requires each community college and public university to have at least 65 percent of the total number of credit hours offered to be taught by full-time employees of the college or university during the 2026-2027 academic year and at least 75 percent of the total number of credit hours offered to be taught by full-time employees every academic year thereafter.
headline: HB 2841 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2841 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2841 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
